text:
kai: Quick help needed on audit-log retention copy for SOC2 section. Drafting short paragraph + migration checklist + tiny SDK examples.

maria: Keep it concise and link to KMS. Where will snippets live?

kai: Under docs/security/audit-logs.md and mirrored in sdk/reference.

jen: Suggested wording: 'Default audit log retention is 90 days. Extended retention can be arranged via contract; retention requests are subject to regulatory constraints.'

samira: Legal: use 'default' and avoid hard promises unless product default exists. Also add routing note to sales/contracting for extended retention.

kai: Noted. Adding data-minimization line: 'By default we retain only audit metadata (request id, timestamp, actor); payloads are redacted unless explicitly requested.'

maria: Add migration checklist: 1) export legacy logs 2) validate schema 3) re-ingest into new export pipeline 4) confirm redaction/default retention.

kai: Curl snippet for export API - please sanity-check:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit-exports" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"from":"2024-01-01","to":"2024-03-31","redact":true}'
```

jen: Python SDK sample looks good: from redwood import AuditClient; client.create_export(from_date="2024-01-01", to_date="2024-03-31", redact=True)

samira: Add note: 'Exports are encrypted in transit and at rest; see Key Management docs.' Also: 'Exports are provisioned temporarily; for long-term archival use customer storage or request dedicated retention.'

docs-bot: PR opened by kai: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1489 (labels: docs, compliance)

maria: I'll do a quick tone pass after you push updates.
kai: Thanks all, will update PR and route extended retention requests to sales per Samira.
